appraisal_events.evidence: ravie que la table fût justement si intéressante le jour où M. de Forcheville venait pour la première fois
appraisal_events.explanation: Mme Verdurin is glad the salon happens to be putting on a lively show precisely on Forcheville's first visit, implicitly treating him as a newcomer whose good impression she wants to secure.

status_effects.explanation: As a first-time guest whose reception the hostess is anxious to make favorable, Forcheville is positioned as someone being courted into the salon's valued circle.
